subject: Biweekly Council Meeting Schedule
overview: The Medford City Council voted to amend its rules to hold regular meetings every two weeks rather than weekly starting September 1, 2022, following significant debate and public comment. The council also confirmed an appointment to the Election Commission, approved a restaurant license and an extended-hours permit, and discussed youth mental health and West Medford development.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Tabled the records of the May 3, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Special Permit for Crumbl Cookies
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Crumbl Cookies at 23 Revere Beach Parkway to operate extended hours until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays, attaching the permit to the business rather than the location.

items.title: Common Victualler License for The Ford's Tavern
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Mystic Dining, LLC doing business as The Ford's Tavern at 61 Locust Street following a brief recess to review documentation.

items.title: Election Commission Appointment of Rebecca Amami
items.summary: Confirmed Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn's appointment of Rebecca Amami to the Election Commission for a term expiring March 30, 2026, despite debate regarding her municipal election voting history.

items.title: West Medford Square Development Task Force
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the mayor appoint a task force composed of local property owners and stakeholders to examine future development in West Medford Square.

items.title: Study and Action Plan on Youth Mental Health
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution urging the city and school department to study youth mental health, develop an action plan, request the Behavioral Health Commission's annual report, and refer discussions to the public health subcommittee.

items.title: Subcommittee Report on Beautification Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a committee report referring a proposed ordinance to create a city beautification committee to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Military, Jewish American, and AAPI Heritage Months
items.summary: Approved three resolutions recognizing May as National Military Appreciation Month, Jewish American Heritage Month, and Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month.

items.title: Grant of Location on Winthrop Street
items.summary: Tabled a petition by National Grid and Verizon to relocate a utility pole near Lorraine Road and Winthrop Street because no representative was present.

items.title: Council Rules Update on Meeting Frequency
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the council rules shifting regular meetings from weekly to every two weeks effective September 1, 2022, to allow dedicated time for subcommittees, over objections from dissenting members and residents.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard resident remarks praising Medford High School pool staff during the pandemic and inquiries concerning public expenditure lists for sidewalks and tree stump removal.
